description.value:
Wondrous item, common

Component: Aberration (Paradox Jinn) heart

Different versions of this device, such as a Chronosphere and a Chronopyramid, were ultimately rejected for not being sufficiently alliterative. A Chronocone was briefly in consideration.

Paradox Prevention. In its default state, this item glows with a soft blue colour. While you are holding or carrying the Chronocube and are involved in a situation where you may earn 1 or more Paradox Points, such as being in the vicinity of a past version of yourself or having a conversation that might result in leaking vital information to a creature in the past (GM's discretion), the cube's glow shifts to a vivid red.

Uncommon variant: The item has the Retrocausal Shielding property.

Retrocausal Shielding. While you are holding or carrying the Chronocube and gain 1 or more Paradox Points, you can take a Reaction to reduce the number of points gained by 1. Once you use this property, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Rare variant: The item has the Retrocausal Shielding and Reality Mending properties.

Reality Mending. While you are holding or carrying the Chronocube, you can use a Magic action to take 4d8 Force damage and lose 1 Paradox Point. This damage can't be reduced or prevented by any means. Once this property of the cube has been used, it can't be used again for 7 days.
